hints.tr: Dizinin sonuna bir `WHERE` yazılabiliyor; dizin yalnızca o koşula uyan satırları tutuyor: `CREATE INDEX ad ON tablo (sütun) WHERE koşul;`.
hints.en: A `WHERE` can be written at the end of an index; the index then holds only the rows that meet it: `CREATE INDEX name ON table (column) WHERE condition;`.

hints.tr: Koşul `amount` üzerinde olmalı: `WHERE amount IS NOT NULL`. (`event_type = N'purchase'` bu veride aynı satırları seçse de denetim `amount` süzgecine bakıyor.)
hints.en: The condition has to be on `amount`: `WHERE amount IS NOT NULL`. (`event_type = N'purchase'` picks the same rows in this data, but the check looks for the `amount` filter.)

hints.tr:
Sorgunun tamamı:

```sql
CREATE INDEX ix_events_amount ON events (amount) WHERE amount IS NOT NULL;
```
hints.en:
The whole query:

```sql
CREATE INDEX ix_events_amount ON events (amount) WHERE amount IS NOT NULL;
```

checks.query: SELECT STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN ic.is_included_column = 0 THEN c.name END, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ic.key_ordinal, c.name) AS key_columns, STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN ic.is_included_column = 1 THEN c.name END, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ic.key_ordinal, c.name) AS included_columns, i.is_unique, i.filter_definition FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id = i.object_id AND ic.index_id = i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id = ic.object_id AND c.column_id = ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id = OBJECT_ID('events') AND i.is_primary_key = 0 GROUP BY i.index_id, i.is_unique, i.filter_definition ORDER BY key_columns;
